info.title: Agron Mobile (unofficial)
info.description: Unofficial, reverse-engineered description of observed Agron Mobile requests, checked October 26, 2026. Not a vendor-supported API or a guarantee of availability. Sources: https://agronmobile.libnet.co.il/config.js, Scripts/Server/Server.js, Scripts/App/Login.js, Scripts/BLM/User.js and Scripts/Views/TitleInfoView.js. Schemas describe consumed fields and permit additional fields. Application validation may be stricter than the wire description. Generic HTTP 500 responses do not distinguish missing memberships from backend failures.

post.description: Called once per server. Authorization is Basic followed by base64(TZ:TZ:) with an empty database. After selection, use the returned dBName in the third field.

get.description: Select the group named loans for active loans; history may be included as a separate group. Ordering is not a contract.

200.description: Observed flat history list; no verified pagination.

post.description: State-changing request. The official UI sends an array of copyNo values. Response semantics are unverified: HTTP 200 is not proof of renewal. Re-read the selected loan and compare datePromise; never automatically retry this POST.

200.description: Response body intentionally unconstrained; verify via a fresh loans read.

MobileAuthorization.name: Authorization
MobileAuthorization.description: Precomputed header: Basic followed by a space and base64(TZ:TZ:database). This is the client's three-field format, not ordinary two-field HTTP Basic credentials. Preserve leading zeros; send only to the configured HTTPS servers. Contains personal credentials; never log.

UnknownError.description: Error response semantics are not fully known. A generic 500 is unavailable knowledge, not a confirmed missing membership or renewal rejection.

userid.description: TZ as a string, including leading zeros.

LocalTimestamp.description: Observed ISO local timestamp such as 2026-10-23T00:00:00, not necessarily timezone-qualified. The app preserves the displayed calendar date. Null means unavailable.

CopyId.description: Native copyNo, not a catalog title number. Preserve its JSON type.

Loan.description: Consumed loan fields. The additional loan-level idNo was observed as an integer unrelated to the login TZ; it is not used as account identity. Membership identity comes from login and the selected server/database.
